subject: Error when attempting to connect to SQL server from shinyapps.io with library RODBC

messages.author: 3e06ee807fca2679
messages.subject: Error when attempting to connect to SQL server from shinyapps.io with library RODBC
parts:
My code works fine on my Windows computer in RStudio. When i share it on the shinyapp hosting service i get the error below. I need a solution which can been handled in code since i cannot install or change local files on the server.
The problem is that the connection doesn't open.

Code:
con.text <- paste("DRIVER=",driver.name,
                  ";Database=",database,
                  ";Server=",server,
                  ";PROTOCOL=TCPIP",
                  ";UID=", username,
                  ";PWD=",password,sep="")

con1 <- odbcDriverConnect(con.text)

res <- sqlQuery(con1, 
                          "select * 
                          from DB", 
                          stringsAsFactors = F)

Error Log:
2017-08-23T11:32 shinyapps[]: Warning in odbcDriverConnect(con.text) :
2017-08-23T11:32 shinyapps[]:   [RODBC] ERROR: state IM002, code 0, message [unixODBC][Driver Manager]Data source name not found, and no default driver specified
2017-08-23T11:32 shinyapps[]: Warning in odbcDriverConnect(con.text) : ODBC connection failed
2017-08-23T11:32 shinyapps[]: Error in value[[3L]](cond) : first argument is not an open RODBC channel

messages.author: 299a5089d6c6c523
messages.subject: Re: Error when attempting to connect to SQL server from shinyapps.io with library RODBC
parts:
What is the value of "driver.name"?
Is value of "server" an IP address or hostname that is publicly accessible from the Internet?
Does your firewall allow the IP addresses of the shinyapps.io service to connect to your database server?

http://docs.rstudio.com/shinyapps.io/applications.html#accessing-your-local-databases-from-shinyapps.io
